import glob, subprocess, os
files=glob.glob('/workspace/tmp/scogs_fungi/*.treefile')
vals=[]
for f in sorted(files):
    out=subprocess.check_output(['/opt/agent-venv/bin/phykit','treeness',f], text=True).strip()
    try: v=float(out)
    except Exception as e:
        print('bad',f,repr(out),e); continue
    vals.append((v,f))
print('n',len(vals))
print('gt',sum(v>0.06 for v,f in vals))
print('ge',sum(v>=0.06 for v,f in vals))
print('pct_gt',sum(v>0.06 for v,f in vals)/len(vals)*100)
print('pct_ge',sum(v>=0.06 for v,f in vals)/len(vals)*100)
print('min max mean',min(v for v,f in vals), max(v for v,f in vals), sum(v for v,f in vals)/len(vals))
print('zero',sum(v==0 for v,f in vals))
# print sorted around threshold
for v,f in sorted(vals):
    if 0.04 < v < 0.1:
        print(os.path.basename(f),v)
PY"
